scope.target: Separate acceptance-to-evidence reconciliation, immutable validation head, and independent exact-head audit
constraints: Narrow tests first and fail closed
Long-running selected validation uses one read-only external task and one callback/event wait
Planned commit messages pass the canonical preflight before git commit
Any post-audit tracked mutation invalidates the audit
non_goals: Provider checks or admission without authorization
Push, PR, merge, Issue/Project mutation, target release, tag, Release, or publication

steps: Create durable commits only after planned-message preflight
Dispatch applicable long-running validation from a clean immutable head
execution.last_completed_step: Focused owner validators and external packet compatibility cases passed; sandbox-only Temp and Git Bash failures were preserved as blocked evidence.
execution.next_action: Run the final focused and projection gates with permitted host temporary access, commit after planned-message preflight, then delegate aggregate validation and obtain exact-head independent audit.
